name: Unified Gaussian Splatting Renderer Dispatch
definition: A unified rendering function that dispatches to specific Gaussian rasterizers (3DGS, 2DGS, or GGGS) based on the model's scale dimensions or explicit mode flag, handling data preparation (means, opacities, SHs) and post-processing of rasterizer outputs (depth, normals, alpha).
summary: Unified Gaussian Splatting Renderer Dispatch is a unified rendering function that automatically selects the appropriate Gaussian rasterizer backend based on input scale dimensions or explicit mode flags.
